subject: ela
intro: Writers can use computers and tablets to type, fix, and share their work. A keyboard types letters. A spell-checker shows possible spelling mistakes. We can save, print, and share our writing online. Third graders know these tools and how they help.

items.prompt: What tool on a computer shows you a word that might be spelled wrong?

steps: A spell-checker finds possible spelling mistakes.
So the tool is the spell-checker.

items.prompt: What do you press to type letters on a computer?

steps: You type letters with the keyboard keys.

items.prompt: To keep your writing so you do not lose it, you should ____ the file.
To make a paper copy of your writing, you ____ it.
A tool that catches spelling errors is a ____.
